title: Source-owner registration tests use real source-owner deadlines; make them deterministic
outcome: The tests in src/tests/test_run_registration_source_owner.rs exercise source-owner registration without real wall-clock deadlines. Pins and authorities are either injected at the existing verifier seam, or the deadlines run on a scripted clock, so scheduling delay can never turn an expected result into a deadline error.
acceptance: Every test in src/tests/test_run_registration_source_owner.rs, including source_owner_registration_refuses_an_unconfigured_project_without_a_code, obtains its expected pin, refusal or authority without depending on a real-time deadline (Instant::now() + ENGRAM_SOURCE_COMMAND_BUDGET): through the verifier seam or a scripted clock. The tests still assert the same observable results.
No product behaviour changes. The tests pass in a registered run, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
